name: 53094 · Watertown, WI
findings: ZIP 53094 (Watertown) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53094 (Watertown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Housing organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
